# netactuate_oidc_client_key (Resource)

Manages an OIDC Client Key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_oidc_client_key" "example" {
  label          = "example"
  oidc_client_id = 12345
  public_key     = "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIEexamplekeyexamplekeyexamplekeyexamplekey example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Display label for the key
- `oidc_client_id` (Number) OIDC client ID
- `public_key` (String, Sensitive) Public JWK value. The parent netactuate_oidc_client must NOT set jwks_uri: the two ways of supplying keys are mutually exclusive and the API rejects the combination with HTTP 400.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for the key

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key_id` (Number) OIDC client key ID assigned by the API
- `provided_on` (String) Timestamp when the key was provided
- `type` (String) Key type

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_oidc_client_key.example 12345
```
